references.source: Cook (1974) J. Struct. Div. ASCE 100(ST9):1851-1863 (problem); converged vertical displacement at the mid-point of the loaded edge 23.96 (64x64 incompatible Q4), 23.92 (64x64 compatible Q4), best value 23.9 per Bergan & Felippa (1985) CMAME 50:25-69, as reproduced in ENERCALC 3D verification C-04 (https://media.enercalc.com/ec3d_verification/c-04-(cook-membrane-problem).htm)
references.notes: No closed form. Literature values 23.9 (Bergan & Felippa), 23.91 (smoothed-FEM papers), 23.92-23.96 (64x64 meshes); 1% tolerance covers the spread. Checked here: structured compatible Q4 meshes reproduce the published 4x4/8x8/16x16/64x64 values (18.29, 22.08, 23.43, 23.92) at (48, 52); Q9 32x32 gives 23.961.
